footer.brandDesc: Redefining fashion bags with minimalist aesthetics. We believe true elegance comes from an unwavering pursuit of detail.

home.designTimeless: Design that stands the test of time
home.brandDesc: We are a brand passionate about design. Starting with our first tote bag in 2018, we've believed in one thing—simplicity withstands the test of time. By reducing unnecessary ornamentation and focusing on materials, proportion, and function, we craft each bag to be your elegant companion in daily life.
home.betterWithAgeDesc: A bag that gets better with age. Italian-grade microfiber leather—your reliable companion for the daily hustle.
home.qualityDesc: Cheap bags fall apart in a season. Ours get better. We use SGS-certified high-density nylon and Italian-grade microfiber leather. No loose threads, no fading colors. Just a reliable companion for your daily hustle.
home.ecoDesc: Wear your values. Every stitch tells a green story.
home.ecoStory: Every stitch tells a green story. Our bags are made from post-consumer recycled PET and certified vegan materials. By choosing us, you're not just buying a bag—you're keeping 15 plastic bottles out of the ocean.
home.ecoMaterialsDesc: Crafted from recycled fabrics & vegan leather.
home.userFriendlyDesc: Simplify your daily life. Open-flat design with padded shoulder straps for effortless everyday carry.
home.dailyLifeDesc: Tired of digging through a black hole to find your keys? Meet our "Open-Flat" design. The wide opening lets you see everything at a glance. Plus, the padded shoulder strap protects your shoulder even on heavy grocery days.
home.smartPocketsDesc: 8 organized compartments for 15" laptop & water bottle.
home.handsFreeDesc: Converts from tote to crossbody in 1 second.
home.classicDesc: Simple and versatile, elegant for everyday

brandFeatures.ecoLeatherDesc: Plant-based tanning process reduces chemical usage and is kinder to the environment.
brandFeatures.italianCraftDesc: Each bag is meticulously crafted by experienced Italian artisans—every detail is visible.
brandFeatures.lifetimeWarrantyDesc: We stand behind every product with confidence, offering lifetime quality guarantee service.
brandFeatures.globalSourcingDesc: From raw materials to packaging, we uphold responsible supply chain management.

product.careAvoidMoistureDesc: Avoid exposing the product to rain or humid environments. If it gets wet, gently wipe with a soft dry cloth.
product.careRegularDesc: Use professional leather care products every 3 months to maintain softness and luster.
product.careStorageDesc: When not in use, place the product in its dust bag and store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
product.tagUs: Tag us on social media and showcase your unique look

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.heading: Artisanal Excellence
craftsmanship.intro: We believe true luxury lies in the pursuit of perfection in every detail. Each AXIS O product embodies the dedication and craftsmanship of skilled artisans, with every step executed with precision.
craftsmanship.materialsDesc: We only use the finest materials to ensure every product stands the test of time.
craftsmanship.material1Desc: SGS certified, scratch-resistant, lightweight yet durable
craftsmanship.material2Desc: Soft touch, premium quality, comparable to genuine leather
craftsmanship.processDesc: From design to finished product, every stage undergoes rigorous quality control to deliver perfection.
craftsmanship.step1Desc: Senior designers create and refine until perfection
craftsmanship.step2Desc: Strict material selection, precise fabric cutting
craftsmanship.step3Desc: Experienced artisans bring each product to life
craftsmanship.careDesc: Proper care keeps your AXIS O bag in optimal condition for years. Clean regularly, avoid prolonged sun exposure, and store with dust bag protection.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.heading: Making a Difference
sustainability.intro: We believe fashion and sustainability can coexist. AXIS O is committed to reducing environmental impact and practicing sustainable development.
sustainability.whyDesc: The fashion industry is one of the most polluting globally. Over 92 million tons of textile waste are landfilled or incinerated annually. We're determined to change this.
sustainability.whyDesc2: By using recycled materials, optimizing production, and reducing packaging waste, we're building a more sustainable fashion future.
sustainability.initiativesDesc: Every small action makes a big difference. Here's how we're practicing sustainability.
sustainability.initiative1Desc: Using post-consumer recycled PET bottles and regenerated nylon
sustainability.initiative3Desc: Optimized supply chain, reducing carbon emissions
sustainability.initiative4Desc: Ensuring all partners follow fair trade principles
sustainability.impactDesc: Since our founding, AXIS O has recycled over 1 million plastic bottles, reduced 50 tons of carbon emissions, and prevented significant waste from entering oceans. But this is just the beginning - we'll continue working for a better planet for future generations.
sustainability.callToActionDesc: Every choice is a vote for a sustainable future. Choosing AXIS O means choosing to make a difference for our planet.
